fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) rose as much as 6,400% following Western Digital spinoff but recently declined over 70% from peak, with 8:1 stock split executed November 8.
fields.summary_ko.1: AI data center construction surge created NAND memory supply shortage providing strong pricing power, though 2027 year-end stock price expected near $170.
fields.summary_ko.2: Given memory chip industry volatility, potential oversupply risk, and raw material price correlation, current 5x P/E multiple may be a trap rather than undervaluation.
